name: Golpo
long_description:
Golpo AI is the world's best platform to create fully produced whiteboard explainer videos from just a prompt or document. Instead of hiring an agency, you simply input a prompt or document explaining what you want, and in minutes you get a whiteboard explainer video in a style similar to Khan Academy or RSA Animate. After creation, you have the ability to edit all aspects of the video with just prompts. 

It's perfect for training, faceless YouTube, marketing, technical, and educational videos — any video where understanding is important. Trusted by over 170,000 users as of July '26, Golpo features include but are not limited to: 

1) Convert your narration into an explainer video (with your narration as audio and the video time aligned) 
2) Input your document or prompt. Document can be of virtually any format or type (text, audio, video etc.) 
3) Script-to-video with matching audio
4) Videos up to 10 minutes
5) 50+ languages
6) dead-simple editing after generation
7) Insert your own videos and images into the generation, used as-is without alteration.
8) 10+ visuals styles, including pen in hand, voice cloning, vertical video, custom branding and more! API access available.

launches.body:
# TL;DR

Hi, we're Shraman and Shreyas Kar, brothers and founders of Golpo AI: the most powerful AI whiteboard explainer video generator. Golpo is the world's best platform to create fully produced whiteboard explainer videos from just a prompt or document.

Instead of hiring an agency, you simply input a prompt or document explaining what you want, and in minutes you get a whiteboard explainer video in a style similar to Khan Academy or RSA Animate — in 50+ languages.

After creation, you can edit all aspects of the video with just prompts. Perfect for training, faceless YouTube, marketing, technical, and educational videos — any video where understanding is important.

Ask: Create your first video for free:[ ](https://video.golpoai.com)[video.golpoai.com](http://video.golpoai.com)

# The Problem

If you want a whiteboard explainer video today, you either hire an agency for thousands of dollars and wait weeks, learn professional video editing software which takes months to get good at and still requires a ton of time per video, or use a DIY whiteboard animation tool where you'll spend hours dragging elements around and the result still looks amateur.

# Our Solution:

Put in a prompt or document, get a professional fully produced whiteboard explainer video in minutes. After generation, you can edit all aspects of the video with just prompts. Videos can be anywhere from 15 seconds to 30 minutes (via API).

With our proprietary video generation engine, Golpo produces videos that feel authentic and engaging in a way no other AI video generator does.

Create your first video free and look at other videos created with Golpo at [video.golpoai.com](http://video.golpoai.com)

# The Team

We are both brothers and **Stanford CS students** and have been building together our entire lives. 

Shreyas Kar (CEO):

* Researcher at Stanford’s Vision & Learning Lab under Dr. Fei-Fei Li
* Co-Founder of the Stanford AI Club
* USA Math Olympiad qualifier, RSI scholar, and ISEF Grand Prize winner

Shraman Kar (CTO):

* International AI Olympiad bronze medalist (Team USA)
* Research at Stanford Translational AI Lab (on foundational AI Vision models) and with Harvard Medical School Portal Group
